provenance.reporter: native Rust make jsb / final-native report
provenance.ttfm: schema build start through first ready mask; vocabulary preparation excluded
provenance.tbm: commit previously allowed token through next ready mask
provenance.tbm_cohort: complete valid trajectories accepted by every compared engine; no shared prefixes of failed or incorrect trajectories
provenance.ttfm_cohort: common successful builds; build success is not semantic correctness qualification
provenance.native_control_policy: EOS inside native ready-mask timing; other model controls excluded unless constrained as exact IDs; no external mask postfilter
provenance.timing_qualification: One wall-clock pass without CPU pinning, cpuset isolation or SMT sibling reservation. Checkpoint staging, verification and publication overlapped the living benchmark child. Retained telemetry cannot separate intrinsic work, scheduling, steal-time or frequency effects. Latency isolation/stabilization is not certified.

tail.estimator: sampled empirical inverse survival function; ascending zero-based index N-ceil(x*N/100)
